details: RANKED PLAY Call of Duty: Warzone Ranked Series In-Season Compete in the Season 05 Reloaded Call of Duty: Warzone Ranked Play Event, featuring 50-player leaderboards with Emblem and Weapon Camo rewards for top placements across all Ranks.
We know many players enjoy the movement and outplay potential Grappling Hooks provide.
Stim Stims are no longer interrupted when the player takes 1 point of damage.
We wanted to make Stims feel more reliable in situations where players are taking very small amounts of damage.
Previously, even a single point of damage could interrupt the Stim animation, which could make the item feel inconsistent and overly punishing.
This change allows players to complete their Stim when taking minimal chip damage while still preserving the intended risk of healing during combat.
Sticking a Juggernaut with a Semtex now deals damage equal to 20% of their health.
Explosive damage against Juggernauts increased by 30%.
These changes should reduce situations where multiple Juggernauts appear too close together, while the Semtex and explosive damage adjustments give players stronger options for dealing with them.
New Attachments RK-9 Calibrated Strike System (In-Season) Calibrated barrel paired with specialized bloom rounds that expand mid-flight and deal maximum damage when fired within a specific range.
Includes an indicator to prompt the user when they are within that ideal range.
Silently fires two projectiles at once with improved ballistics but harms overall handling and mobility.

Stim Stims are no longer interrupted when the player takes 1 point of damage.
We wanted to make Stims feel more reliable in situations where players are taking very small amounts of damage.

Includes an indicator to prompt the user when they are within that ideal range.

We know many players enjoy the movement and outplay potential Grappling Hooks provide.
Stim Stims are no longer interrupted when the player takes 1 point of damage.
We wanted to make Stims feel more reliable in situations where players are taking very small amounts of damage.
Previously, even a single point of damage could interrupt the Stim animation, which could make the item feel inconsistent and overly punishing.
This change allows players to complete their Stim when taking minimal chip damage while still preserving the intended risk of healing during combat.
Sticking a Juggernaut with a Semtex now deals damage equal to 20% of their health.
Explosive damage against Juggernauts increased by 30%.
These changes should reduce situations where multiple Juggernauts appear too close together, while the Semtex and explosive damage adjustments give players stronger options for dealing with them.

We know many players enjoy the movement and outplay potential Grappling Hooks provide.
Stim Stims are no longer interrupted when the player takes 1 point of damage.
We wanted to make Stims feel more reliable in situations where players are taking very small amounts of damage.
Previously, even a single point of damage could interrupt the Stim animation, which could make the item feel inconsistent and overly punishing.
This change allows players to complete their Stim when taking minimal chip damage while still preserving the intended risk of healing during combat.
Sticking a Juggernaut with a Semtex now deals damage equal to 20% of their health.

These changes should reduce situations where multiple Juggernauts appear too close together, while the Semtex and explosive damage adjustments give players stronger options for dealing with them.

Includes an indicator to prompt the user when they are within that ideal range.
Silently fires two projectiles at once with improved ballistics but harms overall handling and mobility.
